app.name: ArkMCL
cli.help:
Usage: arkmcl [OPTIONS] Commands: account Manage accounts (default: --list) help Print this help info Print runtime information as JSON instance Manage instances (default: grouped list) launch Manage runs (default: running instances) resource Browse, search, and download resources service Service status and stop version Print version account: [...] Select accounts (wildcards allowed); lists matches when no action is given --add Add an account: no name = Microsoft device code; name = offline; with --server = external login --default Set the default account (only one) --list List accounts grouped by type --refresh Refresh tokens; refreshes all Microsoft accounts when no selector is given; cannot be combined with --add, --remove, or --default --remove Remove accounts (batch requires confirmation) --server External login server (used with --add) instance: [...] Select instances (wildcards allowed); lists them by group when no action is given; with --create, use as the instance id --account Set or query the instance account --create Create an instance (requires --name and --version without an id) --create-defaults Whether to copy default config files (default: true) --default Set the default instance (only one) --group [] Set or query the group; reads or writes the global default without a selector, lists groups when used alone without a value --group-move Move every instance in a group to another group (mv-like) --import Import a local or HTTPS .mrpack --info Print instance information; uses the default instance when no selector is given --jvm-args [] Set or query JVM arguments; default = Aikar flags, none = clear; reads or writes the global default without a selector --linking [] Query or update shared links: all|none|name list; with no selector and no value, prints the global default; all|none sets the global default --list List instances by group --loader Set or query the loader: client fabric|forge|neoforge; server fabric|forge|neoforge|purpur|vanilla --loader-version Set or query the loader version --lwjgl Override the LWJGL version (default restores it) --memory [] Set or query the memory limit; reads or writes the global default without a selector; client >=512, server >=256 --move Change the instance id (directory name) --name [] Set or query the name (requires one instance) --remove Move instances to the system trash (batch requires confirmation) --type [] Instance type: client|server; only takes effect on create, query-only afterwards --version [] Set or query the Minecraft version; reads or writes the global default without a selector launch: [...] Select instances (wildcards allowed); lists running instances when no action is given --account Account to log in with --list List running instances --prepare Validate and fill in missing resources --start Start an instance and attach the console --stop Force-terminate instances (batch requires confirmation; use --terminal and send stop for a graceful shutdown) --terminal Attach the console; input goes to the process, ^C detaches resource: --api

Resource provider: modrinth|curseforge (search, lookup, and download) --autoremove List global resources not referenced by any instance; add --yes to move them to the trash --download ... Download resources; use --download-version to pick versions --download- Download by type: mod, modpack, resourcepack, shader, datapack, world, plugin; non-modpacks require --download-to-instance --download-to-instance Download into an instance (modpacks are global only) --download-version Version to download; the count must match --download --filter-loader <...> Loader filter, repeatable --filter-vanilla <...> Version type: all|stable|snapshot|foolsday|legacy, repeatable --filter-version <...> Game version pattern, repeatable --list List local resources (default) --list-limit Limit output rows (1-100) --list-remote List Minecraft versions; with --filter-loader, list loader versions --list-sort Sort direction --list-sort-by Sort keys: local create|alphabet; search and loaders create|download|name|relevance; versions create|launch|alphabet --lookup Show project versions --search Search community resources (requires --type) --type worlds|resourcepacks|datapacks|shaderpacks|mods|plugins|modpacks service: status Show service status (does not start the service) stop Stop the service (does not start the service) Options: -h, --help Print this help --json Print machine-readable JSON --lang Language: zh-CN or en-US --list-sort List order, default asc --list-sort-by Sort keys: create, launch, run, alphabet -V, --version Print version --yes Skip batch confirmations

cli.account.add:
Usage: arkmcl account add [<name>] [--server <url>] [--uuid <uuid>]

  no arguments       Sign in with Microsoft
  <name>             Add an offline account
  --server <url>     Add an external account
  --uuid <uuid>      Optional UUID for an external account
